results.title: Hafiz Naeem says JI will not join any grand opposition alliance
results.description: Speaking during a meeting with senior journalists in Lahore, Hafiz Naeem said past political alliances had caused more harm than benefit to the Jamaat-e-Islami

results.title: Odisha CM to hold public grievance hearing at Unit-2
results.description: Bhubaneswar: Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi will organize a public grievance hearing in Bhubaneswar offering the opportunity to citizens to interact directly with him on their problems and issues. The hearing would be conducted at the old Government Primary School at Unit-2 in Ashok Nagar, Bhubaneswar.
